nodes.label: GSAP Pinned Title Card (Layer 1)
nodes.rationale: Uses pinSpacing:false + end:bottom-top so section height drives scroll distance without injecting extra space; quickSetter chosen for frame-perfect opacity with no scrub lag or competing tweens

nodes.label: GSAP Parallax Columns (Layer 2)
nodes.rationale: scrub:true chosen for instant lag-free parallax; two columns staggered with different pt offsets to create depth without animating y on a pinned element

nodes.label: gsap.quickSetter Pattern
nodes.rationale: Preferred over scrub tweens for frame-sensitive single-property control; avoids competing tween conflicts on pinned elements
